The simulated fc is 1.00 MHz, about 6% above the 943 kHz the program predicted. Every other spec passes with margin. fc moves almost proportionally with f_trim (+5.93% per +10%), so a small trim fixes it.

```json
{"action": "refine", "reason": "Topology and DC point are fine; only fc is ~6% high (1.00 MHz vs 940 kHz target). fc tracks f_trim almost proportionally, so start f_trim at 0.94 and widen its lower bound to center fc in the window.", "params": {"f_trim": 0.94}, "bounds": {"f_trim": [0.85, 1.02]}}
```
